content:
maria: heads up — CI flagged a new vuln in our base image (glibc CVE) during nightly scan. thinking we should do a minimal rebuild + signed rollout today. impact: all runtime pools that use base:v2025-04
jon: ack. which images exactly? runtime-prod/base:v2025-04?
maría: yes runtime-prod/base:v2025-04 and runtime-staging/base:v2025-04. staging is green but prod shows some hits in vulnerability-triage.
alex: quick plan idea: 1) produce minimal rebase with updated glibc 2) cosign-sign with KMS 3) canary deploy to a labelled pool 4) run vuln scans + smoke 5) promote gradually
sara: add RBAC/QS checks: infra sa used by build pipeline needs cloudkms.signer role (or equivalent). also need image-push permission to our registry and cosign verify access to KMS key for runtime nodes
maria: good call. jon can you check current SA perms?@jon
jon: checking now. current build-sa has registry push + kms.cryptoSignSecretVersion (GCP) but NOT the new kms.asymmetricSign role that cosign with KMS requires. will request infra change.
jon: also QA: runtime nodes need permission to verify signature? cosign verification uses public key, but if we use KMS-backed signing, the verify step only needs access to public key — we can cache it. runtime doesn't need KMS decrypt access.
+sara: audit log req: we need to ensure KMS key usage is logged and sent to SIEM. enable Data Access logs for KMS + Container Registry push logs forwarded to logging project. ops-oncall: can you confirm retention window?
oncall-ops: SIEM team requires 90d retention for key usage + 365d for image push events. we'll loop in security-logging.
deploy-bot: pipeline triggered: image-rebuild/minimal-rebase — run id 2026-04-3832 (canary tag will be base:v2025-04-rebase-3832) :rotating_light:
alex: cosign command we've used before (GCP KMS example):
```bash
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/my-proj/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/rebuild-key base:v2025-04-rebase-3832
```
maria: when we sign with KMS remember to use key with asymmetric signing, not symmetric. otherwise cosign flow breaks. kms-bot: any constraints?
kms-bot: KMS key policy: disable keyversion import, schedule auto-rotation every 90d, add IAM binding for build-sa:roles/cloudkms.signer and for logging-sa:roles/cloudkms.viewer. logs enabled.
jon: can we use ephemeral signing container instead of exposing key to CI agents? i prefer ephemeral runner that calls KMS directly via short-lived token.
sara: yes use workload identity for the ephemeral runner. adds one extra permission step but avoids long-lived creds.
maria: canary details: label nodes with `rebuild-canary=true` pool size 3. route 1% traffic initially, smoke tests: perf, memory, auth flows. if any regression auto-rollback to previous image.
alex: rollout policy in Console: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full with 30m windows. add automatic vulnerability re-scan gate after each step.
oncall-ops: I'll standby for the window 18:00-21:00 PT. if anything fires alert paging will escalate.
jon: one more RBAC item: runtime image-puller sa needs to be able to fetch public cosign key from storage (we put it in bucket). grant storage.objects.get to runtime-puller-sa on `signed-keys` bucket.
maria: logging checklist: ensure AuditLog: "protoPayload.methodName": ["google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyService.AsymmetricSign", "storage.objects.insert", "containerregistry.v1.PushImage"] forwarded.
sara: vuln triage note — some of the hits are low-severity backported packages. we'll mark those as accepted for this rebase if upstream fix isn't available, but escalate any medium/high to patch priority.
alex: post-mortem / runbook updates: add steps for rollback, cosign revoke (revoke key version if bad), and how to re-sign older images if needed.
maria: timeline: rebuild and sign at 18:30, canary at 19:00, hold for 1h, then promote if green. tagging convention: base:v2025-04-rebase-3832-signed
jon: I'll post the PR for IAM changes and ping infra for quick approval, link: https://git.internal/r/iam/PR-1234 :thumbsup:
sara: i'll update the audit-forwarding playbook and notify SIEM.
maria: thanks all. if any blocker post here. :eyes:
